statements.statement: The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
Palpitations have not been adequately characterized by standard short-term monitoring
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247) is indicated
The service was billed with CPT code 93247
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that care may be covered by another payer in accordance with coordination of benefits protocols
A 30-day continuous ECG monitor is medically necessary to characterize the frequency and burden of the patient's arrhythmic episodes
